errors.text_span: The legend indicates that the blue bars correspond to Greedy decoding, the orange bars to RPG decoding, the green bars to Greedy decoding with CodeLlama-34B, and the brown bars to RPG decoding with CodeLlama-34B.
errors.evidence: The description of the legend is inaccurate and incomplete. For the first two series, it omits the model name (e.g., "Greedy decoding" instead of the full "Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)"). It also misidentifies the color of the fourth series ("RPG (CodeLlama-34B)") as "brown" when it is burnt orange, and ambiguously calls the second series "orange", failing to distinguish between the two orange-hued bars.

The description provides a structural overview of the chart but completely omits the quantitative data presented. It does not mention any of the performance values (i.e., the heights of the bars) for any of the four metrics, which is the primary information the chart is intended to convey.
